question: What result can be obtained by worshipping the inscribed diagram in any place?
premises: The inscribed diagram is to be worshipped.
Success in recitation is the stated attainment.
This attainment is possible wherever the worship is performed.
inference: By worshipping it, one may obtain success in recitation wherever one may be.
plain_english: Having worshipped it, one may indeed obtain success in recitation wherever one is.
